tests.name: Familiarity Consolidation
tests.desc: M55 familiarity rises, L2 prediction error falls, for a repeated tone.

tests.name: Novelty Detection
tests.desc: Salience and curiosity spike when a never-heard frequency appears.

tests.name: Sequence Learning
tests.desc: Prediction error falls and Thought confidence rises as A→B→A→B sequence is learned.

tests.name: Curiosity Drives Attention
tests.desc: Curiosity and salience are higher during novel multi-tone exploration than after learning.

tests.name: Planning Emergence
tests.desc: M57 planning weight grows as sequences become predictable. Deliberation overrides habit more.
